posts.text: oh wow the month is gay again

It's coming up on two decades now of tech companies pushing digital automated personal assistants whose primary advertised feature set is "streamline purchasing stuff"

We already had the Amazon Dash button come and go, which was peak form on that front. Move on.
Bad grammar I did for sure but not what I meant ofc
(The other rule is “don’t be among the last things I’m editing into the video when I’m trying to get it out the door)
I probably have more rules than that but I mean that’s the one I’ve got on file

Mikie Sherrill will no longer be receiving the coveted "still has the background of their photo intact" status in next week's SKH episode

she broke the literal one rule I have which is "don't actively impede protestors at a concentration camp where the hunger striking detainees are being abused"

Just passed a kids birthday party where the birthday boy just happened to kick a soccer ball up into the air only for it to land squarely on the birthday cake

Life is mostly self inflicted pain, glad he's learning that early
the fed doesnt have the right to abuse people without due process so I feel like it evens out

Kinda zoning out while cleaning the kitchen and damn near filled up my sugar scoop thing with flour

Woulda made for some INTERESTING tea
We used to have politicians willing to literally duel to the death over policy. What happened

Seems actually so easy to just be like “hey so everyone worth the carbon they’re made of generally agrees that you are human scum, so I’m gonna steamroll you instead of listen to you claiming you have authority here”

"Actually, I am the governor of this state and I'm not going to back down from stamping out human rights violations in my jurisdiction just because some military reject told me that a child rapist doesn't want me to enter this facility"

...is the response I'm waiting to see from any governor
I’ve also been quietly busy cooking up something new in the “online community stuff” space here for the past few weeks and hope to have more to share eventually

I’m proud of that fact
